additions.partial_pearson_additional_controls: Also correlate U and signed error after removing both centered actor-distance and centered Q1 (equivalently Q1 margins from the state's maximum). Use a two-column least-squares projection only when both controls are full rank; otherwise record undefined. This is descriptive partial association, not trained predictive-model validation.
additions.q_margin_definition: Q1(action) minus maximum Q1 in the same candidate bank; centered margins equal centered Q1
additions.decision_event_decomposition: For the already fixed BCA3 versus actor-distance0.1 selectors, report frequency of different selected indices, mean value gain conditional on differing indices, and unconditional mean gain. Verify unconditional mean equals disagreement frequency times conditional mean; zero differing choices gives conditional gain undefined and unconditional gain zero.
additions.event_scope: Different indices, not positive-return differences, define the event. Count conditional wins, losses and near-equal returns separately. Do not present enriched-event benefit as population-average benefit.
additions.candidate_bank_informativeness: Report per-state value range, raw-Q candidate-bank regret and positive-regret frequency, best-candidate ambiguity, fixed-method decision disagreement, and their batch/time summaries. Finite-bank limitations remain explicit.
additions.planning_interpretation: No practical effect threshold has been chosen. Any numeric sample counts are illustrative normal-approximation calculations from development-only variance, not a sample-size recommendation, power guarantee, or authorization to expand confirmation.
additions.validation_if_future_model_fit: Any future learned diagnostic model must validate by held-out state/episode groups; no learned predictive model is fitted in this descriptive audit.
additions.stochastic_noise_distinction: Inputs are authenticated deterministic simulator continuations under a deterministic frozen policy, so conditional Monte Carlo sampling noise is absent. This does not assert exact real arithmetic, generalize to stochastic returns, or resolve error from target-policy mismatch.
